ev.q: the incidence of NAS has increased approximately 400% nationally, from 1.2 per 1,000 hospital births in 2000 to 5.8 in 2012
Aggregate hospital charges for all infants with NAS in 2012 were estimated to be $1.5 billion
Public health measures to prevent and treat opioid dependence before and during pregnancy are essential
recommends that clinicians address the unique sensitivities of prescribing opioid medications to pregnant women
